messages:
IncidentBot: page fired -> latency-slo-burn for inference-api-eu-west (p99 > 1200ms). PagerDuty incident: PD-3456. Autopager: policy=latency-p99, threshold=1200ms.
Sam: acked the PD-3456, I'm taking lead. Looking at dashboards now :eyes:
PagerDuty: PD-3456 acknowledged by Sam. Escalation paused.
Elena: I'm on infra checks. Any obvious deploys? I don't see recent model rollouts in eu-west.
Mike: No deploys from platform in the last 30m. Quick glance at metrics: KV-cache eviction rate spiked, queue depth for hotpath increased. p95 ~120ms -> normal, but p99 ~1300ms+.
Priya: hitting autoscaler headroom, but autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough for the burst. Might be cold KV shards causing extra I/O. Starting a targeted kv-warmup job into eu-west pools.
Sam: running the runbook step: `./runbook.sh investigate-kv-evictions PD-3456` and issuing warmup. Code snippet I'm running:```bash
# warmup keys for top-10 hotkeys
./tools/kv-warmup --region eu-west --shards 1..4 --top 10
```
Priya: warmup started on dedicated-pool-2 (eu-west). Also temporarily routing 25% of traffic to dedicated-pool-2 as fallback: `infra route set --service inference --pool dedicated-pool-2 --weight 25`
Leah: CS checking for customer reports. No inbound tickets yet, monitoring support Slack.
Mike: attaching quick telemetry: top latency buckets show amplification on requests with long sequences and cold KV lookups. Suggest keeping routing shift until p99 < 900ms for 10m.
Sam: noted. I'm also bumping suffix cache TTLs for the hot prefix set to reduce future reads.
Elena: PagerDuty suppression note: autopager suppression window applied after manual ack; PD will not escalate while we have an active ack. Please add short checkins every 5m.
Priya: autoscaler tweak in progress: increasing burst headroom from 5% -> 20% in eu-west to let sidecars spin up faster. Applying: `infra autoscale update --service inference --region eu-west --headroom 20`
IncidentBot: PD-3456 status: acknowledged -> in progress.
Sam: after warmup p99 trending down: 10m ago p99 1300ms, 5m ago 850ms, now ~720ms. p95 steady ~140ms.
Mike: logs show request retries down and KV IOPS dropping. Good sign. Keeping dedicated-pool route active but lowering weight to 10% to reduce cost.
Priya: lowered route weight to 10%. Warmup still running to fully populate hotkeys.
Leah: CS: still no customer reports. Posting a note to the weekly incident digest that this was mitigated by KV warmup + routing fallback.
Elena: handoff plan: Leo will be on next shift in 15m. I'll update on-call rotation and paste final metrics snapshot there. If p99 stays <900 for 10m we can resolve and close PD.
Sam: agreed. Adding a temporary alert suppression rule so we don't reopen PD during controlled rollout: `alertctl mute --id latency-slo-burn --dur 10m --reason "mitigation in progress"`
IncidentBot: PD-3456 will be resolved when current active acknowledgement is closed.
Sam: final checkin before handoff: p99=680ms, p95=130ms, KV eviction rate back to baseline. Will close if stable for next 10m. :white_check_mark:
Elena: thanks team — handoff to Leo in 10. Keeping the channel open for any regressions.
PagerDuty: PD-3456 marked as resolved by Sam (condition met).
Leah: adding postmortem note: root cause likely cold KV shards + autoscaler hysteresis; follow-ups: 1) improve warmup on scale events, 2) adjust autoscaler aggression thresholds, 3) add canary routing for hot keys.
Sam: filing follow-ups in the eng backlog now. Closing thread once Leo confirms stability.
